file_impact.reason: Reimplement reconciler_repo_root() as a validated layered fallback (REBAR_ROOT -> validated package root -> validated git-toplevel-of-cwd -> clear error); add _is_repo_checkout and _git_toplevel_of_cwd helpers.

Step-7 siblings: route the two repo_root=None fallbacks (lines ~507, ~626) through the validated config.reconciler_repo_root() instead of the raw Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] package-location default, which is the same non-editable-install defect.

RED tests for reconciler_repo_root Option C legs (raise-on-non-checkout, validated CWD fallback, behavior-preserving controls) plus a construct-uniqueness guard that no reconciler site derives repo_root from a raw Path(__file__) package-location fallback.
